large bending or snapping can expose constitutive-model limitations. Independent rheometer
measurements use different strain/frequency conditions and are not automatically exact ground
MPM as well. The distinction for TaichiDough must concern the dough law, measurements, or
demonstrated result—not just two moving effectors.
